claims.claim_text: DAG runner implementation for governance workflow enforcement is being built and tested on the dag_test branch
claims.classification_rationale: CLAUDE.md Section 15 explicitly requires orchestration-based workflow enforcement and declares the workflow definition in .claude/workflows/system-orchestration.yaml as the authoritative execution specification. Building a DAG runner to enforce this workflow is a direct implementation of a current constitutional requirement. The work is tooling/infrastructure, not a change to system architecture, snapshot contracts, or Layer 2/3 boundaries.
notes: This is governance enforcement tooling, not a core system component
Does not affect snapshot contract or data flow architecture

claims.claim_text: Modifications to DAG runner modules (executor, execution_backend, models, prompt_assembly, state_store, diagnostics) constitute infrastructure changes to the governance enforcement mechanism
claims.classification_rationale: These are internal implementation modules of the governance DAG runner. They do not touch Layer 2 snapshot logic, series registry, or any downstream computation. The changes are scoped entirely to the orchestration enforcement layer described in CLAUDE.md Section 15.

claims.claim_text: Test modifications for the Claude Code CLI backend support the DAG runner implementation
claims.classification_rationale: Test coverage for governance tooling is standard development practice. The test file targets the execution backend specifically, which is the interface between the DAG runner and the Claude Code CLI. This is purely an internal tooling concern.
